title: Semialgebraic interior layers in root closures of bounded-height integer polynomials
summary: Finite-degree root plots of bounded-height monic integer polynomials can exhibit gaps around interior points of their root closures. Outside the closed unit disk, these closures coincide with Mandelbrot sets for affine iterated function systems with collinear digits. We construct explicit semialgebraic interior layers, certified when finite inverse orbits enter canonical self-covering parallelograms. Such parallelograms exist exactly in the non-real lens, which contains the non-real locus precisely from twenty maps onward. Within the non-real lens, limits of each capture level are captured…
